tasks.title: Put admin on your home screen
tasks.tip: Had a CMS Admin icon from before? Press and hold it, tap {Remove}, then add it again with these steps.

steps.caption: On your phone, open cmscookieco3more.com/kitchen in Safari (iPhone) or Chrome (Android).
iPhone: tap the Share button (square with an arrow), then {Add to Home Screen}. If you see {Open as Web App}, switch it off. Tap {Add}.
Android: tap the three dots ⋮ in the corner, then {Add to Home screen}. Chrome asks {Install} or {Create shortcut}: tap {Create shortcut}, then {Add}.
Tap the new {CMS Admin} cookie icon any time. Your kitchen opens.
About once a month it asks for your email and a code. That's normal. Then you're back in.

tasks.title: Fix a photo (frame it, brighten, add words)
tasks.tip: Changed your mind? {Undo}, {Start over} and {Cancel} are always there. Nothing is saved until you tap {Save} on the form.

steps.caption: Anywhere you add a photo, tap {Choose photo}. Or tap {Take photo} to use the camera.
Drag the photo with one finger to move it. Pinch, or slide {Zoom}, to make it bigger.
Photo too dark? Slide {Brighten} to the right.
Tap {Add words}, type them, and pick a style: pink ribbon, script or bold.
Tap {Add to photo}. Drag the words where you like, pinch to resize, then tap {Done}.
Happy with it? Tap {Use this photo}.

tasks.title: Set the Cookie of the Month
tasks.tip: Only the newest Cookie of the Month shows. Pick an {Ends} date and it comes down by itself.

steps.caption: Tap {Specials} at the bottom of the screen.
Tap {+ New special}. (To change last month's, tap {Edit} on it instead.)
Change {Type} to {Cookie of the Month}. Type the {Title}, {Description} and {Price}.
Tap {Choose photo}. Frame your cookie in the circle, then tap {Use this photo}.
Tap {Save}. It shows at the top of the home page right away.

tasks.title: Post a special
tasks.tip: Need to take it down early? Tap {Edit} and switch off {Show on the site}.

steps.caption: Tap {Specials}, then {+ New special}.
Leave {Type} as {Special}. Type a {Title}, a short {Description} and the {Price}. No price? People can text you instead.
Tap {Choose photo}. Specials show as a wide picture, so frame it in the wide box.
Pick an {Ends} date so it disappears on its own.
Tap {Save}.

tasks.title: Add an event
tasks.tip: A PDF flyer? Take a screenshot of it and use the screenshot.

steps.caption: Tap {Events}, then {+ New event}.
Type the {Title}, pick the {Date}, and add {Details} like the time and place.
Under {Flyer}, tap {Choose photo}. The whole flyer is used, nothing gets cut off. Tap {Use this photo}.
If people should sign up, paste the link in {RSVP link}.
Tap {Save}. The event leaves the site by itself after the date.

tasks.title: Add a new flavor
tasks.tip: Only around for a season? Fill in {Starts} and {Ends} and it shows up and comes down by itself.

steps.caption: Tap {Menu} at the bottom of the screen.
Tap {+ Add a flavor}.
Type the {Flavor name}, a {Short name} for the box buttons, and a {Description}.
Tap {Choose photo}, frame the cookie in the circle, and tap {Use this photo}.
Leave {Part of the Cookie Tasting Flight} on if it goes in the flight. Tap {Save}.
It's in the box builder now. Use {↑} and {↓} to move it in the list.

tasks.title: Add a new treat
tasks.tip: Treats show in a {More Treats} box on the home page, with an {Add} button so people can order them.

steps.caption: Tap {Menu}, then {+ Add a treat}.
Type the {Treat name} and {Price}. {Kind of treat} is optional, like “Cookie Cake”.
Tap {Choose photo}. Want a price tag on it? Tap {Add sticker}, then {Price tag}.
Tap {Use this photo}.
Tap {Save}. Switch it off any time to hide it.

tasks.title: Change a price or turn something off
tasks.tip: Switched off things disappear from the site, and nobody can order them, until you switch them back on.

steps.caption: Tap {Menu} at the bottom of the screen.
Tap a price and type the new one. Tap anywhere else and it saves by itself.
Out of something? Tap its switch to turn it off. Tap again to turn it back on.
Grey means hidden from the site. Green means people can order it.

tasks.title: Confirm an order and mark it paid
tasks.tip: New orders also arrive in your email. {Open} shows orders that still need confirming or paying; {All} shows everything.

steps.caption: Tap {Orders}. New orders are at the top with a pink {New} tag.
Tap {Text} to message the customer and agree on the details.
All set? Switch on {Confirmed}.
When they've paid, switch on {Paid}. Done orders drop off the {Open} list.
Tap {All} to see older orders again.

tasks.title: How customers pay you
tasks.tip: Nobody pays through the website. Venmo and Cash App money goes straight into your Venmo or Cash App, and cash is paid when they pick up.

steps.caption: Tap {Payments} at the bottom of the screen.
Customers only see the ways that are switched on. After they order, they get a button that opens Venmo with the amount and order number filled in.
To change your Venmo name, tap the box and type the new one. Tap anywhere else and it saves by itself.
Want Cash App too? Type your $cashtag, then switch Cash App on.
Money came in? Tap {Orders}. The Venmo note has the order number in it.
Find that order and switch on {Paid}.

tasks.title: Share a tip video
tasks.tip: Video from your phone? Tap {Video} instead and choose it. First time only on iPhone: Settings → Camera → Formats → Most Compatible. If a video won't upload, post it as an Instagram reel and paste the link.

steps.caption: Tap {Media} at the bottom of the screen.
Easiest: in Instagram, open your reel, tap Share, then Copy link. Here, tap {Instagram link}.
Paste the link and write a {Caption}.
Leave {Feature on the home page} on. The newest one becomes the Tip of the Week.
Tap {Add}.
